source.title: Code Isn't Memory: A Structural Codebase Index Inside a Coding Agent
source.summary: Empirically tests adding a structural codebase index to a coding-agent harness on SWE-PolyBench Verified and SWE-bench Pro, benchmarked against an agentic-grep baseline. Reports a large localization gain and a statistically separated resolve gain at a lower cost-per-solve than agentic grep.
